normalized_text: webloom's drift-lint resolves 'path.md § heading' pointers with ambiguity refusal; harnex evidence verifies only [file: path:line]. no shipped template writes a section pointer in a verifiable form yet, so the strategy has no consumer — add it when a rule template first needs a heading-stable citation
decision_text: The condition the observation set for itself is met and the work is already done. Anchor::Section exists in evidence/claim.rs and evidence/internal.rs resolves it through the CommonMark reader, and five shipped review-lenses templates now write the '[file: path § Heading]' form. Both halves of the observation — no verifier, no consumer — are false as of today.
